newsitem.title: USA: Helen of Troy weighs 2-for-1 stock split. [CORRECTED 15:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Helen of Troy weighs 2-for-1 stock split. [CORRECTED 15:50 GMT]

text.p: Helen of Troy Ltd said its board may consider a 2-for-1 stock split to be paid as a 100 percent stock dividend.
The company, seeking to increase its number of authorized common shares to 50 million from 25 million, filed a preliminary proxy statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Shareholders will be asked to approve the recommendation at the annual shareholders meeting August 26 (corrects from August 17).
The additional common shares would also be available for future acquisitions, stock dividends or other stock distributions, the company said in a press release.
Helen of Troy last declared a stock split on June 5, 1996.
